title: Password Sharing Incident
briefing: Two employees admit they occasionally share a password for a shared system account to save time. What is the most appropriate response?
options: Allow the practice since it improves productivity
Remind them not to share passwords but take no further action
Require individual accounts and enforce password policy
answer: Require individual accounts and enforce password policy

feedback.Allow the practice since it improves pro: Incorrect. Password sharing removes accountability and significantly increases security risk.
feedback.Remind them not to share passwords but t: Partially correct but insufficient. Policy reminders alone do not fix systemic access control issues.
feedback.Require individual accounts and enforce: Correct. Individual accounts maintain accountability and allow proper access auditing and control.
